Name: ToggleMusic
Author: MaltoseMatt1
Description: Adds a hotkey that toggles music on or off, by swapping the music volume between zero and a preset value. Hotkey defaults to "L" and preset volume defaults to 0.15, but both can be changed in the config file or with the Generic Mod Config Menu. The hotkey works during events (so you no longer have to stand around awkwardly while a character silently plays an instrument or dances), but there is also a setting you can enable in the config to have music turn on automatically for events.

Downloads.Description: Added the option to enable music automatically for events.
